title: 负债10亿：想吞无债公司？，Aurora拒绝
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Miguel, you and the board say this under values aurora. I get that. I understand the sentiment certainly.
segments.zh: 米格尔，你和董事会认为这个报价低估了Aurora的价值。我理解这种看法。

segments.en: Apart from that, though, why do you think this is not in shareholders best interests?
segments.zh: 但除此之外，你为什么认为这不符合股东的最佳利益？

segments.en: Well, first and foremost, thanks for having us to talk about this important point. So when we looked at this offer, you know, we look at the totality of the offer and it is our responsibility to do
segments.zh: 首先，感谢邀请我们讨论这个重要问题。当我们审视这个报价时，我们看的是整体，我们有责任为股东做最好的选择。

segments.en: what's best for shareholders. So the first thing the company did is establish a special committee for that was some of the best advisors in North America and you reference the director circular
segments.zh: 公司首先成立了特别委员会，聘请了北美最优秀的顾问，你提到的董事通函中包含了独立的估值意见。

segments.en: in there. You see an independent opinion on valuation. You've also seen comments from some of the leading analysts in the cannabis space, particularly TD Cowan, all talk about the inadequacy
segments.zh: 你也会看到一些领先的分析师，特别是TD Cowan，都在谈论这个报价的不足。

segments.en: of this offer. And so I think it really comes down to three points. The first point is the actual price for with a cap of five dollars doesn't recognize the innate value of these assets.
segments.zh: 所以我认为归结为三点。第一，实际价格上限5美元，没有认识到这些资产的内在价值。

segments.en: Secondly, for a company that is debt-free with almost 150 million in cash being looked at to take, you know, paper from a company is over a billion dollars in debt and trades on a secondary exchange.
segments.zh: 第二，对于一家无债务、拥有近1.5亿现金的公司，接受一家负债超过10亿且在次级交易所交易的公司权益资产，似乎不合理。

segments.en: This doesn't seem to make sense for our shareholders. And lastly, when you look at the way the offer sort of lands in terms of, you know, common multiples and other valuations, it just doesn't seem
segments.zh: 最后，从常见的倍数和其他估值来看，这个报价似乎不够。

segments.en: to be there. So therefore, we've made the recommendation or shareholders. They get to make the final determination in Canada. It's 105 days. And so this process will continue. And we've put a lot of
segments.zh: 因此，我们向股东提出了建议。在加拿大，股东有105天的时间做最终决定。这个过程会继续。

segments.en: information for our shareholders on Protectorora.com where they can see these details that were laid out
segments.zh: 我们在Protectorora.com上为股东提供了大量信息，他们可以看到这些细节。
